name: Heidelberg Materials
title: Press release: Heidelberg Materials with strong growth trajectory in the second quarter 328.98 KB

read.thesis: Q2 revenue up 6% to €6,044m but RCOBD margin fell to 23.4% from 24.2%; RCO guidance top end trimmed to €3.65bn, with growth coming from acquisitions rather than volume recovery.

triggers.label: RCO guidance top end cut to €3.65bn
triggers.quote: now expects RCO between €3.40 billion and €3.65 billion (previously between €3.40 billion and €3.75 billion)

triggers.label: First noticeable recovery in demand
triggers.quote: A first noticeable recovery in demand in our core markets contributed to the good business performance

triggers.label: Exit from Kazakhstan cement
triggers.quote: completed the sale of 100% of its shares in Bukhtarma Cement Company LLP, Kazakhstan, on 8 July 2026

guidance.quote: now expects RCO between €3.40 billion and €3.65 billion (previously between €3.40 billion and €3.75 billion)
ROIC is still expected to be slightly above 10%.
Heidelberg Materials is confident that it will exceed the target of €500 million in savings by the end of 2026.
